_comment: The two ends of the set's material chain. Everything metal aboard strips down to scrap alloy (see `crafting.salvage_rules` in rules/ruleset.json), and the fabrication recipe turns salvaged parts into a patch kit. `item_scrap_alloy` also has no family: it is what things are made of here, not a thing salvaged from the station, so a rule that looks for `salvaged_part` cannot accidentally ask for it.

item_scrap_alloy.name: scrap alloy
item_scrap_alloy.description: Cut and flattened plate, sorted by nobody. The station's only real currency.

item_servo_cluster.name: servo cluster
item_servo_cluster.description: A palm-sized block of actuators, still greasy.

item_cell_stack.name: cell stack
item_cell_stack.description: Layered charge cells, none of them matched.

item_lattice_shard.name: lattice shard
item_lattice_shard.description: A splinter of grown crystal lattice, warm to the touch.

node_salvage_bench.name: salvage bench
node_salvage_bench.description: A stripped workbench with one drawer still full of parts. It will not restock itself.
